conclusions: One explicit prospective error_history=[] initializer before the first persisted supervisor record addresses the identified healthy-record schema gap. It does not certify completion or cleanup.
Actual error append order, first cause, status, source, clock, ownership, resource and cleanup behavior remain unchanged. Missing/null/wrong history must not be normalized into an empty list.

Both complete strict consumers are necessary: task seal verification and provider verification independently require explicit empty history. The existing hand-built dictionaries and patched usage_summary scaffold do not establish actual producer interoperability.
The future positive fixture is conditional on a separately authorized and reviewed producer successor. Current frozen producer is an expected negative baseline for both consumers.
The proposed hash cascade correctly includes the isolated coordinator successor, outer HELPERS, task_entry.COOR_SHA and immutable source bindings. Private config repinning alone is insufficient.
future_acceptance_conditions: Freeze and independently review the actual minimal successor and exact fixture source before any implementation execution. Preserve both strict auditor predicates and every usage/source/resource/cleanup gate.

Run actual complete supervise/error/save and both complete consumer functions with reviewed whole-function/helper/global closures. Inject only external synthetic interfaces; no hand-built healthy supervisor or patched usage_summary is acceptable positive evidence.

Bind actual first save, returned record, saved JSON bytes, SHA, synthetic seal and inline record. Keep task-style and provider-style arguments distinct. Synthetic acceptance proves only serialization and consumer ABI.

F4 requires actual escaping save/hash/persist failure to remain a failed or nonreturned whole call with its durable prefix and enclosing exit/handoff binding preserved. A matched stale saved record can satisfy consumer-local SHA/history/status checks; unchanged consumers alone cannot establish freshness or reject that matched record. No successful producer roundtrip may be claimed from it.
Publication escape handling is not repaired or admitted by these plans. Any separately proposed handling must be reviewed before implementation; no new authority or controller framework is inferred.

Future native or research qualification needs separate root admission and actual complete evidence. Proposed30s/1MiB/96-file synthetic limits are planning constraints, not measured or admitted runtime bounds.
scope_limit: This review accepts only the bounded source plans and their explicit conditional future checks. It grants no implementation, fixture execution, integration, runtime, benchmark, three-hour completion or ML qualification.
